name: owner-session-contract-execution-plan
title: Owner session contract for stable multi-host leases
description: Write an execution plan for a canonical LATTICE_SESSION_ID owner-session contract so Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity/agy, and future hosts do not rely on per-command parent process ids for story owner lease identity. This is high impact for parallel Lattice development because unstable owner-session derivation can make the same worktree look foreign across shell command invocations.
